title: The xenon world in one likelihood: what LZ, XENONnT and PandaX-4T (past, untouched and future) jointly say and should jointly do
question: How much xenon-TPC exposure exists (analysed, untouched, archival), how many 200-270 keV NR events should the unexamined part contain under LZ's best fit (L10; inelastic delta=300/350/366/380 keV), what would 0/1/2/3/5 found events mean (Z, rate interval, P001/P020 posterior, P034 timing), and what would a coordinated pre-registered joint reanalysis settle by mid-2027 versus separate publications?
headline_result: Only 2.84 of 22 t yr of xenon-TPC data on disk have been examined above 200 keV; the remaining 19.1 (16-24) t yr should hold 2.3 (L10) to 5.2 (delta=366 keV) events at 200-270 keV under LZ's best fit (P(>=1) = 0.90-0.995; 0.50-0.79 at the lower 68% edge); two found events give 5.5 sigma local (5.4 sigma global with three pre-registered spectra vs 4.9 from three separate 616-model papers), zero exclude the L10 best fit at 90% and cut delta>=366 to <0.44 of it; a mid-2027 joint 24 t yr dataset reaches 5 sigma with probability 0.73-0.98 if the best fit holds
model_or_mechanism: xenon-target universality of dR/dE; WimPyDD L10 and inelastic O1 spectra (1 TeV, P050 cache) normalised to 1 LZ event; LZ-like erf efficiency vs published hard ROI edges; Poisson counting in 200-270 keV, flat-prior Gamma rate intervals, Poisson-Gamma predictive, P001/P020 three-hypothesis posterior, P034 sqrt(N) timing scaling, Gross-Vitells trials factor, Asimov Z and CLs exclusion
confidence: medium - normalisations reproduce P005/P020/P035/P050 and P001/P020 posteriors, but untouched XENONnT/PandaX-4T exposures are recalled to +-50% and other TPCs' high-energy acceptance/MSSI are assumed LZ-like
agent_tools: Read x22, Bash x25, Write x2, Edit x14, Skill x1 (dataviz)
software_and_packages: python 3.12.13; numpy 2.5.3; scipy 1.18.1 (stats.poisson/gamma/nbinom/norm, special.erf, integrate.quad, optimize.brentq); pandas 3.0.5; matplotlib 3.11.2; common/lzcommon.py; WimPyDD 2.0.4 via P050 spectra cache
local_inputs: PAPER_GUIDE; dossier; ledger; papers P001/P005/P012/P020/P021/P034/P035/P038/P050; P050 spectra cache + tables + script; P038 acceptance CSV; P005 counts/summary; P020 tables + code; P034 required_exposure; P035 summary; lzcommon.py; ENVIRONMENT_versions
recalled_knowledge: 13: XENONnT 3.1/PandaX-4T 1.54/XENON1T 1.0/LZ SR1 0.9 t yr (certain); LUX, PandaX-II exposures and fiducial masses (likely); untouched XENONnT 2-5 and PandaX-4T 1.5-3.5 t yr, ROI edges (uncertain); run dates (likely); Poisson-Gamma, Asimov, CLs, trials formula (certain)
